# xero-ai-review-gateway
> High-density context for AI safety auditors, LLM architects, and security engineers.

## Package Overview
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ryanduguid/xero-ai-review-gateway (ElizabethAnneAlexander)
- **Domain**: Fixed-policy, zero-network security perimeter and synthetic data review harness for AI-assisted trial balance review.
- **Core Principles**: Privacy-by-design, data minimisation, deterministic pre-validation, complete air-gapping of confidential client data.

## Architectural Boundaries
1. **Zero-Network Invariant**: Prohibits outbound network transmissions, external API calls, or cloud LLM routing during confidential data processing.
2. **Synthetic Data Sandbox**: Public tests execute strictly against non-client synthetic data schemas.
